Why were no bodies ever found at the Titanic?
More than fifteen hundred people died.
When the wreck was finally found in 1985...
explorers saw shoes, coats, and belongings.
At that depth, sea creatures eat everything soft.
Then the water itself takes over.
According to Robert Ballard, the man who found the Titanic, the deep ocean lacks the minerals that keep bones intact...
so exposed bones slowly dissolve away.
But the victims left one heartbreaking clue.
Across the sea floor, shoes lie in pairs...
Each pair marks the place where a person once came to rest.
